newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips sluggish, techs up in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips sluggish, techs up in mixed trade.

text.p: U.S. blue chips drifted in a narrow and negative range on Monday afternoon, while technology stocks stayed sturdy despite lingering concerns about higher rates and inflation.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was down around 33 points to 8162, somewhat hampered by further declines in the bond market. The long bond lost 19/32 to yield 6.50 percent.
But the Nasdaq composite held gains, rising seven points to 1601 in mixed trade.
Technology market heavyweight Intel Corp added strength to that sector, gaining 2-15/16 to 96-1/16.
